title: Parking Allocation System
tagline: Knows which spots are open before you circle the lot.

meta.title: Parking Allocation System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Knows which spots are open before you circle the lot.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Drivers waste time and fuel searching for parking, and manually managing space allocation doesn't scale with a busy lot.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Real-time object detection identifies vacant and occupied spots continuously and surfaces accurate availability to drivers.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Less circling, less congestion, and fewer manual errors in space management.
